name: P25E — read the route the chest walk is actually given

steps.note:
RUN IT WITH:  node tools/shoot.mjs --keep-title --url http://localhost:8123/index.html --out /tmp/p25e --script scenarios/P25E-route.json --timeout 180000

A pathfinder that only says 'no route' cannot be debugged. This reads the waypoints themselves for the walk the player reported — the way out of the chair, and the way up to the chest on the loft — and asks of each one the question that matters: can the boy's own body stand there? `endsOnMark` is false BY DESIGN, the mark being inside the chest; what it must not be is a route that ends somewhere he can never reach, or one that sends him the long way round the furniture.
1. the way out of the chair — the route B1's own first step needs
2. the way up to the chest, from the chair

steps.eval: (()=>JSON.stringify(__DQ.route('at:the chest at the foot of your bed')))()

steps.note: 3. and from the other side of the room, because a route that only works from one tile is a lucky seed

steps.eval: (()=>JSON.stringify(__DQ.route('at:the chest at the foot of your bed')))()

steps.note: 4. the tiles ON the loft beside the chest, and what the boy's body makes of each — the question the search answers for itself, read out loud
5. the whole loft floor, sampled, so the pocket the search offers is visible against what exists
